Title: [Describe the bulk ledger posting scenario — e.g. 'Payment-fee bulk posting sent to LEDGER when ShouldBillFees = False']
Component: [COMPONENT — ORD/PAY/SHP/INV depending on which module initiates the bulk]

Step Action: Create [entity] with Status = Open, FeePeriod.EndDate = <EndDate>, FeeSchedule.Amount = <FeeAmount>, and <CorrelationId>
Step Expected: [Entity] is stored with the listed values and CorrelationId = <CorrelationId>

Step Action: Trigger the action that initiates the bulk: [e.g. background process detects the expired FeePeriod / background process fires end-of-day]
Step Expected: The [MODULE] module begins the bulk posting flow

Step Action: Search LEDGER bulk postings using <CorrelationId> and open StartBulkCommand
Step Expected:
LEDGER receives StartBulkCommand with:
- BulkReference = [e.g. 'PAY' + <DateTime> + 'FEE']
- BulkType = '[e.g. Payment Fee]'
- BulkName = '[e.g. Payment Fee' + <DDMMYY>]'
- Source = '[e.g. PAY]'

Step Action: Open CreateBulkPostingCommand for <CorrelationId> in LEDGER and inspect its posting header
Step Expected:
LEDGER displays these posting header values:
- PostingIdentifier = [e.g. 'PAY' + <DateTime> + <AccountNumber> + 'Fee']
- BusinessTypeCode = '[e.g. Payment]'
- IsFinal = '[Yes / No]'
- Source = '[e.g. PAY]'
- PostingGroup.GroupTypeCode = '[e.g. Payment Fee]'
- PostingGroup.GroupReference = [e.g. value ending in 'FEE']
- PostingGroup.GroupName = '[e.g. Payment Fee' + <DDMMYY>]'

Step Action: Inspect the order posting for <PostingIdentifier> in LEDGER
Step Expected:
LEDGER displays these order posting values:
- OrderPostingTypeCode = '[e.g. FeeCharge]'
- CaseTypeCode = '[e.g. Scheduled Fee]'
- PostingDate = <BusinessDate>
- ValueDate = <ValueDate>
- DescriptionStoreLanguage = '[e.g. Fee Payment <AccountNumber>]'
- StoreUniqueIdentifier = <StoreNumber>
- StoreClass = [Retail / Wholesale / Internal]
- StoreType = [as stored on Store]

Step Action: Inspect the account line for <PostingIdentifier> in LEDGER
Step Expected:
LEDGER displays this account line:
- AccountUniqueIdentifier = [e.g. Order.BillingAccountNumber when ShouldBillFees = False]
- BookCurrencyISOCode = <CurrencyISOCode>
- UnitPrice = 1
- Quantity = [sum of Book currency amount of attributions]
- AttributionTypeCode = '[e.g. FeeReceivable — check authoritative Attribution type reference page]'
- SourceCurrencyAmount = [e.g. FeeSchedule.Amount * -1] (rounded to currency decimals)
- BookCurrencyAmount = SourceCurrencyAmount

LEDGER receives EndBulkCommand with:
- BulkReference matches the BulkReference from the StartBulkCommand
- NrOfPostings = total number of CreateBulkPostingCommands sent in this bulk
- Source = '[e.g. PAY]'
